#!/usr/bin/env python3

import sys
import os
from gimpfu import *

def move_textbox_to_left(image, drawable):
    # Get image dimensions
    width = image.width
    height = image.height
    
    # Get all layers
    layers = image.layers
    
    # Find the text layer (we'll assume it's the first layer or has "text" in its name)
    text_layer = None
    for layer in layers:
        if "text" in layer.name.lower():
            text_layer = layer
            break
    
    # If no text layer found, use the first layer
    if text_layer is None:
        text_layer = layers[0]
    
    # Get layer dimensions
    layer_width = text_layer.width
    layer_height = text_layer.height
    
    # Calculate new position (left side, centered vertically)
    new_x = width // 4  # 1/4 from left
    new_y = height // 2 - layer_height // 2
    
    # Move the layer
    pdb.gimp_layer_set_offsets(text_layer, new_x, new_y)
    
    # Save the result
    pdb.gimp_file_save(image, drawable, "/app/leftside_textbox.png", "/app/leftside_textbox.png")
    
    # Display message
    gimp.message("Text box moved to left side and saved as /app/leftside_textbox.png")

# Register the plugin
register(
    "python_fu_move_textbox_to_left",
    "Move Textbox to Left",
    "Moves the text layer to the left side of the canvas",
    "Assistant",
    "Assistant",
    "2023",
    "Move Textbox to Left...",
    "*",
    [
        (PF_IMAGE, "image", "Input image", None),
        (PF_DRAWABLE, "drawable", "Input drawable", None),
    ],
    [],
    move_textbox_to_left,
    menu="<Image>/Tools"
)

main()
EOF
